title: Agent Frontmatter
description: Formalizes CLAUDE.md's canonical Agent frontmatter schema for the plugin's own agent files at agents/<name>.md. Validates SHAPE ONLY — the presence, type, and ordering intent of the required frontmatter fields, plus the non-negotiable rule that every agent's skills list includes both glossary-management and methodology-review. It does not validate the agent's Markdown body, only the parsed YAML frontmatter block presented as a JSON object.

name.description: The agent's canonical name, matching the naming convention and equal to the agents/<name>.md filename stem.

description.description: The agent's discovery/matching surface — what it is and when it fires.

role.description: A one-line role identity (role-noun) for the agent.

phase.description: One or more SDLC phases the agent spans (e.g. 'implement' or 'implement, quality').

skills.description: The skills this agent applies. Must be non-empty and, per CLAUDE.md, must include both glossary-management and methodology-review.

allOf.description: Every agent's skills list must include glossary-management.
Every agent's skills list must include methodology-review.

tools.description: Real Claude Code tools the agent may use (e.g. Bash). May be empty for agents that run no shell commands.

produces.description: Optional forward-compat field reserved for the Architecture Review campaign; shape unconstrained here.

domain.description: Optional forward-compat field (logical skill-domain tag); shape unconstrained here.

status.description: Optional forward-compat field (lifecycle status); shape unconstrained here.

capability.description: Optional forward-compat field; shape unconstrained here.
